name: Krokiet
title: Krokiet: free Gemini alternative
hook: Gemini charges you twenty bucks a year to find duplicate files on your Mac. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It hunts down the clutter eating your storage.
features.say: It finds duplicate files, and photos that look alike, even at a different resolution.
Biggest files, empty folders, broken files. It finds those too.
It even spots similar videos, and the same song twice.

caption:
Gemini charges $19.99/year to find duplicate files. Krokiet does it for free 🧹

✅ Finds duplicate files and similar photos
✅ Big files, empty folders and broken files
✅ Similar videos and duplicate music
✅ No ads, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ Download the app from GitHub Releases (no installer). The Mac build is for Apple Silicon, and on first launch your system may ask you to confirm it (Mac: "Open anyway", Windows: SmartScreen). Similar videos needs ffmpeg installed. Gemini's $19.99/year is the yearly plan on the Mac App Store and Gemini is Mac-only.

Comment "SPACE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
